name: Shell Mithral Wizard
body:
Shell Mithral Wizard CR 20

XP 307,200
CE Medium humanoid (human)
Init +8; Senses all-around vision (areas with cameras); Perception +22

DEFENSE

AC 34, touch 15, flat-footed 33 (+14 armor, +4 deflection, +1 Dex, +5 natural)
hp 198 (2d10+8d6+10d10+100)
Fort +18, Ref +9, Will +19; +1 vs. fear
Defensive Abilities 50% chance to negate critical hit or sneak attack; DR 10/adamantine (150 points)

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee +3 longsword +24/+19/+14/+9 (1d8+8/17–20)
Special Attacks intense spells (+4 damage), spell critical
Evoker Spell-like Abilities (CL 17th; concentration +21)

At will—elemental wall (8 rounds/day)
11/day—force missile (1d4+4)

Evoker Spells Prepared (CL 17th; concentration +21, arcane spell failure 25%, save DC 14 + spell-level)

9th—meteor swarm, time stop
8th—mass charm monster (DC 26), mind blank, quickened phantasmal killer, polar ray
7th—banishment, quickened fireball (2), mass hold person, reverse gravity
6th—chain lightning, disintegrate, quickened glitterdust, greater dispel magic, stilled teleport, wall of iron
5th—cloudkill, stilled dimension door, interposing hand, teleport, wall of force (2)
4th—beast shape II, confusion, dimension door, fire shield, stilled fireball, stoneskin, wall of ice
3rd—dispel magic (2), fireball (2), fly, lightning bolt (2)
2nd—acid arrow (2), invisibility, mirror image, scorching ray, web
1st—feather fall, magic missile (4), mount, shield
0 (at will)—detect magic, light, mage hand, message

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 13, Con 20, Int 18, Wis 14, Cha 18
Base Atk +16; CMB +19; CMD 34
Feats Arcane Armor Mastery, Disruptive, Power Attack, Spell Penetration, Vital Strike
Skills Autohypnosis +16, Bluff +24, Disguise +18, Fly +22, Intimidate +27, Ride +17, Sense Motive +16, Spellcraft +23
Languages Abyssal, Aklo, Binary, Common, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Giant, Goblin, Ignan, Infernal
SQ arcane bond (+2 longsword), diverse training
Gear wand of greater invisibility (15 charges), wand of see invisibility (10 charges), +5 moderate fortification mithral full plate, +3 longsword, amulet of natural armor +5, belt of physical might +4 (Str, Con), cloak of resistance +3, headband of vast intelligence +6, ring of protection +4, granite and diamond dust (worth 500 gp), iron sheet and gold dust (worth 50 gp), 3,585 gp
